name: Linux System Administration
certifications: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA, EX200)

beginner.summary: For support engineers, developers and new administrators. Covers installing Linux, the shell, files and directories, editors, permissions, users and groups, processes, packages, systemd services, logs, file systems, LVM, networking, SSH, text processing, Bash scripting, scheduled jobs, archives and backups, and the host firewall, on RHEL-family and Ubuntu servers.
prerequisites: Comfortable using a computer and installing software
Knows what an IP address is
outcomes: Work confidently at the Linux command line
Manage users, permissions, packages, services, storage and networking
Write Bash scripts and schedule jobs
Keep a server secured, logged and backed up

days.topic: Linux Overview, Distributions and Lab Setup
subtopics: What Linux is: kernel, GNU tools and distributions
RHEL, Rocky, AlmaLinux, Ubuntu and Debian compared
Where Linux runs: servers, cloud, containers and devices
Creating virtual machines with VirtualBox or KVM
Installing Rocky Linux 9 and Ubuntu Server 24.04
Logging in on the console and over SSH
Getting help with man, --help and info
Snapshots of lab machines before risky changes
days.lab_task: Build two lab servers, one Rocky Linux and one Ubuntu, take a snapshot of each, log in over SSH and record the kernel version, distribution, disk layout and main directories.
days.deliverable: Lab build notes and a system information sheet for both servers
checks: Kernel and distribution recorded for both servers
Restore a snapshot after a change
Server back to the saved state

days.topic: The Shell and Moving Around the File System
subtopics: The prompt, commands, options and arguments
days.lab_task: Navigate the file system using only relative paths, find commands with history search, list files with wildcards and add two useful aliases to .bashrc.
days.deliverable: Command log and .bashrc changes
checks: Correct files listed with a wildcard
Why a command runs from any directory explained

subtopics: File types and the file command
Disk usage with du and df
days.lab_task: Organise a messy project folder, create links, find files over 10 MB changed in the last week and report which directories use the most space.
days.deliverable: Command log and a space report
checks: Run find for large recent files
Delete the target of a symlink
Link shown as broken and explained

days.topic: Editing Text with vim and nano
subtopics: Why administrators need a terminal editor
Moving, editing and saving in vim
days.lab_task: Edit a configuration file in nano, then make ten timed edits in vim including search and replace, and recover a file from a vim swap file after a simulated crash.
days.deliverable: Edited files and notes on the recovery
checks: Replace a word throughout a file in vim
Back up a config before editing

subtopics: Read, write and execute on files and directories
chmod in symbolic and numeric form
setuid, setgid and the sticky bit
days.lab_task: Set up a shared project directory where the dev group can edit files, new files inherit the group, users cannot delete each other's files and one auditor has read-only access through an ACL.
days.deliverable: Permission commands and test results
checks: Create a file as a group member

days.lab_task: Create users and groups for a team, set password ageing, give one group sudo access for service restarts only and lock a leaver's account.
days.deliverable: Commands, sudoers rule and test results
checks: Restart a service as a team member
Log in as the locked user

subtopics: Finding what uses a file with lsof
days.lab_task: Start CPU-heavy and long-running processes, move jobs between foreground and background, lower a process's priority, stop a hung process with the right signal and find what holds a deleted log file open.
days.deliverable: Command log and notes
checks: Stop a process with SIGTERM then SIGKILL

days.topic: Installing Software with dnf and apt
days.lab_task: Install, update and remove packages on both servers, add a third-party repository with its signing key, find which package owns a file and apply only security updates.
days.deliverable: Command log for both distributions

subtopics: systemctl start, stop, restart and status
days.lab_task: Install and enable a web server, write a unit file for a small script so it runs as a service and restarts on failure, and fix a service that fails to start.
days.deliverable: Unit file and troubleshooting notes

days.topic: System Logs with journald and rsyslog
subtopics: Finding the cause of a problem in logs
days.lab_task: Make the journal persistent, find failed SSH logins in the last hour, configure log rotation for an application log and trace a service failure through the logs.
days.deliverable: Configuration and log extracts
checks: Reboot and query the previous boot
Old log compressed and a new file created

subtopics: Creating partitions with fdisk and parted
days.lab_task: Add a new virtual disk, partition it with GPT, create XFS and ext4 file systems, mount them permanently by UUID, add swap and recover a server that will not boot because of a bad fstab line.
days.deliverable: Commands, fstab entries and recovery notes
checks: Recover from the bad fstab line

subtopics: Physical volumes, volume groups and logical volumes
Extending volumes and file systems online
Moving data between disks with pvmove
days.lab_task: Create a volume group across two disks, create a logical volume for application data, grow it online while files are being written, take a snapshot before a change and move data off one disk.
days.deliverable: LVM commands and before and after output
checks: Data back to the snapshot state

subtopics: Testing with ping, traceroute, ss and curl
days.lab_task: Give each server a static address, set DNS and the hostname, add a static route, find which process listens on port 80 and fix a server that cannot resolve names.
days.deliverable: Network configuration and troubleshooting notes

subtopics: Copying files with scp and rsync
days.lab_task: Set up key-only SSH between the servers, disable root and password logins, create client config shortcuts, copy files with rsync and reach a private server through a jump host.
days.deliverable: SSH configuration and test results
checks: Login to the private server works

days.topic: Text Processing with grep, sed and awk
days.lab_task: Analyse a web server access log with pipes to report the top ten client addresses, error counts by hour and the slowest pages, and change a setting in many config files with sed.
days.deliverable: Commands and reports
checks: Hourly counts correct for a sample hour
All files updated and backups kept

subtopics: Script structure and the shebang line
days.lab_task: Write a script that creates users from a CSV file, validates its input, logs what it does, exits with clear codes on errors and passes ShellCheck.
days.deliverable: Script, sample CSV and test results
checks: Error reported and other rows processed

days.topic: Scheduling Jobs with cron and systemd Timers
days.lab_task: Schedule the user script nightly with cron, rewrite it as a systemd timer that catches up after downtime, prevent overlapping runs and send output to the journal.
days.deliverable: Crontab, timer and service units and logs
checks: Power off over the run time then boot
Second run exits because of the lock

days.lab_task: Back up /etc and a data directory with tar and zstd, set up nightly incremental rsync backups to the second server, delete files and restore them, and record restore time.
days.deliverable: Backup scripts, schedule and restore evidence
checks: Size and time for each recorded

days.topic: Host Firewalls and Basic Server Security
days.lab_task: Allow only SSH and HTTPS on both servers, restrict SSH to the admin subnet, install fail2ban to block repeated failed logins and complete a hardening checklist.
days.deliverable: Firewall rules, fail2ban configuration and checklist

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Building and Running a Web Server
days.lab_task: Build a web server from a fresh install: users and sudo, LVM storage for site data, Nginx as a service, SSH hardening, firewall, log rotation, a scheduled backup script and a restore test, then hand it over with a runbook.
days.deliverable: Build commands, scripts, runbook and restore evidence
checks: Site, mounts and firewall all come back
A classmate can restart and restore using it
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one server

intermediate.summary: For administrators who run Linux servers. Covers advanced Bash, SELinux, performance monitoring, the boot process, kernel tuning, RAID and storage, NFS and Samba, DNS and DHCP servers, Apache and Nginx, central authentication, sudo and PAM, hardening and auditing, Podman, Ansible, patching, backup and recovery, central logging, KVM and RHCSA preparation.
prerequisites: Manages users, packages, services and storage on Linux
outcomes: Secure servers with SELinux, PAM, auditing and hardening standards
Run network services, containers and virtual machines
Automate administration with Ansible and pass RHCSA

subtopics: Functions with local scope and return values
days.lab_task: Write a health-check tool with options, arrays of checks, cleanup on exit, parallel checks against many hosts and bats tests.
days.deliverable: Script, tests and sample output

subtopics: Fixing denials with audit2why and sealert
days.lab_task: Serve a website from a non-default directory and port with SELinux enforcing, fix each denial correctly with contexts, port labels and booleans, and never set permissive mode.
days.deliverable: Commands, denial analysis and working site
checks: Load the site from the new directory

subtopics: CPU with top, mpstat and pidstat
Disk I/O with iostat and iotop
days.lab_task: Diagnose four slow servers (CPU bound, memory pressure, disk bound and network bound) with the USE method, record evidence and apply a tuned profile where it helps.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis report with evidence for each server
checks: Swapping and low available memory found

days.topic: The Boot Process and Recovering Unbootable Systems
days.lab_task: Recover four broken servers: a lost root password, a broken GRUB entry, a missing initramfs and a service that blocks boot, using rescue targets and boot logs.
days.deliverable: Recovery notes for each server
checks: Unit identified in the boot log

days.topic: Kernel Modules and System Tuning with sysctl
days.lab_task: Blacklist an unneeded module, set module parameters, tune network buffers and swappiness with persistent sysctl files and add a kernel boot parameter with grubby.
days.deliverable: Configuration files and verification output
checks: Try to load the blacklisted module at boot

days.topic: Storage: RAID, Stratis and File System Tuning
days.lab_task: Build a RAID 1 array, fail and replace a disk, create a Stratis pool with a snapshot, set user quotas and compare space saved with VDO.
days.deliverable: Storage commands and results
checks: Array degraded and rebuilt after replacement

days.topic: File Sharing with NFS and Samba
subtopics: SELinux and firewall rules for sharing
days.lab_task: Export home directories over NFS and mount them on demand with autofs, share a team folder with Samba for Windows users and fix a permission problem on each.
days.deliverable: Server and client configuration and test results
checks: Open the Samba share from Windows
Files readable and writable by the group

subtopics: DNS concepts: zones, records and resolvers
DHCP with Kea or ISC DHCP
days.lab_task: Run an authoritative zone and a caching resolver with BIND, serve DHCP with reservations and confirm clients get addresses and resolve names both ways.
days.deliverable: Zone files, DHCP configuration and test output
checks: Resolve a name and its reverse

days.lab_task: Host two sites with TLS on Nginx, reverse proxy an application on Apache, load-balance two app servers and confirm failover when one stops.
days.deliverable: Server configurations and test results

days.topic: Central Authentication with FreeIPA and Active Directory
subtopics: Joining Linux to Active Directory with realmd
days.lab_task: Set up a FreeIPA server, enrol both servers, log in with central accounts, apply host-based access control and central sudo rules, and join a third server to Active Directory.
days.deliverable: Enrolment steps, rules and login tests
checks: Log in with a central user
Login works on every enrolled server
Log in where access is not allowed
Log in with an AD account
Login works on the AD-joined server

days.topic: sudo Policy, PAM and Login Controls
subtopics: Testing changes without locking yourself out
days.lab_task: Write sudo rules for three teams with command aliases and logging, enforce password quality and lockout through PAM, and test with a second session open in case of mistakes.
days.deliverable: sudoers files, PAM settings and test results

subtopics: Hardening standards: CIS and DISA STIG
days.lab_task: Scan a server with OpenSCAP against a CIS profile, fix the findings, add audit rules for changes to sudoers and passwd, and detect a changed binary with AIDE.
days.deliverable: Scan reports before and after, audit rules and AIDE report
checks: Pass rate higher with exceptions documented

subtopics: Running containers as systemd services with Quadlet
days.lab_task: Run a rootless web app and database in a pod with persistent volumes, build a custom image with Buildah and run the pod as a systemd service that starts at boot.
days.deliverable: Container definitions, image and service files

days.topic: Managing Many Servers with Ansible Playbooks
days.lab_task: Turn the beginner capstone build into an Ansible role that configures users, firewall, Nginx and backups, run it against three servers and show a second run makes no changes.
days.deliverable: Inventory, role and run output
checks: Run the playbook on new servers
Servers configured with no manual steps
Handler restarts only the affected service

days.lab_task: Mirror repositories locally, patch a test group first, roll patches across production in batches with reboots, roll back a bad kernel and report patch status across all servers.
days.deliverable: Patch process, batch log and status report
checks: No more than one batch down at a time

days.topic: Backup and Disaster Recovery for Linux Servers
subtopics: Borg or restic for deduplicated backups
days.lab_task: Back up a server with encrypted deduplicated backups and retention, create a bare-metal recovery image, destroy the server and rebuild it on a new VM.
days.deliverable: Backup configuration, recovery image and rebuild log
checks: Server boots with data and settings
Old archives pruned to the policy

subtopics: Shipping logs to Loki or Elasticsearch
days.lab_task: Forward logs from all servers to a central rsyslog server over TLS and into Loki, search for failed logins across servers and alert on repeated sudo failures.
days.deliverable: Logging configuration, queries and alert
checks: Log in with a bad password on one server

days.lab_task: Turn a server into a KVM host, create two VMs on a bridged network, snapshot one before a change and roll back, and live-migrate a VM to a second host.
days.deliverable: Host configuration, VM definitions and migration log
checks: Reach a VM from the LAN
VM back to the earlier state
VM keeps running on the new host

subtopics: Time management in a practical exam
days.lab_task: Complete two timed practice exams on fresh servers, reboot after each to check persistence, review every failed task and repeat weak areas.
days.deliverable: Two scored practice exams and a weak-areas list

days.lab_task: Build a small company environment with Ansible: central identity, a web tier behind Nginx, containerised apps, NFS storage, DNS, central logging, hardening scans and backups, then recover a destroyed server and present it.
days.deliverable: Ansible repository, scan reports, recovery evidence and presentation
checks: Back in service from automation and backups
Run the hardening scan on all servers
Pass rate at the agreed level
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one environment

advanced.summary: For senior administrators, SREs and platform engineers. Covers kernel and system call tracing, performance engineering, eBPF, high availability clusters, advanced networking, container internals, crash dumps, golden images, identity at scale, compliance automation, live patching and fleet patching, Linux in the cloud, enterprise storage, systemd resource control, distribution upgrades, incident response, fleet monitoring, production troubleshooting and RHCE preparation.
prerequisites: Uses Ansible, SELinux and performance tools
Comfortable reading logs and kernel messages
outcomes: Diagnose hard performance and kernel problems with tracing tools
Build highly available, compliant and patched Linux fleets
Run Linux well in clouds and containers
Respond to incidents and lead Linux platform work

days.topic: Tracing System Calls and Kernel Behaviour
subtopics: How user space talks to the kernel
days.lab_task: Find why a program is slow by tracing its system calls, profile a CPU-heavy service with perf, produce a flame graph and explain the top three hot functions.
days.deliverable: Traces, flame graph and explanation

days.topic: Linux Performance Engineering: CPU, Memory and I/O
subtopics: CPU scheduling and the CFS and EEVDF schedulers
Huge pages and transparent huge pages
Page cache and dirty page tuning
days.lab_task: Tune a database server: pin processes to NUMA nodes, configure huge pages, pick an I/O scheduler and dirty page settings with fio benchmarks, and show the gain under load.
days.deliverable: Benchmark results and tuning changes
checks: Each change justified by a benchmark

days.topic: eBPF Observability with bpftrace and BCC
days.lab_task: Use BCC tools and bpftrace to find a process causing slow disk I/O, list new outbound connections, measure off-CPU time for a service and write a script for a custom metric.
days.deliverable: Commands, scripts and findings

days.topic: High Availability Clusters with Pacemaker and Corosync
days.lab_task: Build a three-node cluster running a floating IP, a web service and replicated storage with fencing, then fail nodes and the network and measure failover.
days.deliverable: Cluster configuration and failover test results
checks: Services move and the time is recorded
Quorum and fencing prevent split brain

days.topic: Advanced Networking: Bonding, VLANs, Bridges and nftables
days.lab_task: Configure a bonded uplink with VLANs and a bridge, build two network namespaces joined by veth pairs, write nftables rules with sets and route traffic by source with policy routing.
days.deliverable: Network configuration, rules and captures
checks: Works only through the intended path

days.topic: Container Internals: Namespaces and cgroups v2
subtopics: Namespaces: pid, net, mount, user and others
Building a container by hand with unshare
days.lab_task: Build a minimal container by hand with unshare and cgroups, limit its memory and CPU, drop capabilities and enter a running Podman container's namespaces from the host.
days.deliverable: Commands and notes on each namespace and limit
checks: Process killed by the OOM killer in its cgroup

subtopics: Working with vendors on kernel bugs
days.lab_task: Configure kdump, trigger a test crash, analyse the dump with crash to find the panic cause and backtrace, and set up hung task detection.
days.deliverable: kdump configuration, dump analysis and notes

subtopics: Immutable approaches: image mode and rpm-ostree
days.lab_task: Build a hardened golden image with Image Builder and Packer, configure first boot with cloud-init, test and scan it, and promote it from test to production.
days.deliverable: Image definitions, test results and promotion record

days.topic: Identity and Access at Fleet Scale
subtopics: Identity design for thousands of servers
days.lab_task: Add FreeIPA replicas, create an AD trust, replace SSH keys with short-lived SSH certificates, record privileged sessions and run an access review.
days.deliverable: Identity design, configuration and access review
checks: Log in with an expired SSH certificate

days.lab_task: Tailor a CIS profile, scan 20 servers, remediate with generated Ansible, schedule continuous scans with drift alerts and produce an auditor report with exceptions.
days.deliverable: Tailored profile, remediation playbook, reports and exception register
checks: Fleet pass rate at the target

days.topic: Live Patching and Fleet Patching Strategy
days.lab_task: Design a ring-based patch process, apply a live kernel patch without rebooting, roll an emergency CVE fix across the fleet in under four hours and report patch latency.
days.deliverable: Patch process, live patch evidence and latency report
checks: Fleet patched within the time limit
Days from release to patch per ring

days.topic: Linux in the Cloud: AWS and Azure
subtopics: Cloud storage for Linux: EBS, managed disks and file services
Cloud networking from inside the VM
Agents: SSM and Azure guest agents
Serial console and recovery in the cloud
days.lab_task: Launch Linux on AWS and Azure from the golden image, require IMDSv2, manage instances through Systems Manager without SSH, recover an instance with a broken fstab through the serial console and right-size from metrics.
days.deliverable: Launch configuration, recovery notes and right-sizing report
checks: Run a command through Systems Manager
Command runs with no SSH open
Instance boots after serial console fix

days.topic: Enterprise Storage: iSCSI, Multipath and Ceph Clients
days.lab_task: Connect a server to iSCSI storage over two paths with multipath, fail a path under load, mount Ceph RBD and CephFS and compare performance with fio.
days.deliverable: Storage configuration, failover test and performance results
checks: I/O continues on the other path

days.topic: systemd in Depth: Resource Control and Sandboxing
subtopics: Sandboxing options: ProtectSystem, PrivateTmp and others
days.lab_task: Harden three services with sandboxing until systemd-analyze security scores them low risk, limit a batch job's CPU and memory with a slice and reduce boot time with systemd-analyze.
days.deliverable: Unit overrides, security scores and boot time comparison

subtopics: Upgrade paths: RHEL 8 to 9 and Ubuntu releases
Migrating from CentOS to Rocky or RHEL
days.lab_task: Upgrade a RHEL 8 server to RHEL 9 with Leapp after fixing the pre-upgrade report, migrate a CentOS server to Rocky Linux and roll back one upgrade with a snapshot.
days.deliverable: Pre-upgrade reports, upgrade logs and fleet plan
checks: Server on RHEL 9 with applications working
Server restored to the earlier version

subtopics: Live response: processes, connections and persistence
days.lab_task: Investigate a compromised lab server: find the malicious process, its network connection and persistence, collect evidence, contain the host and write the incident report.
days.deliverable: Evidence log, findings and incident report
checks: Cron job, unit or key added by the attacker found

subtopics: What to monitor on Linux servers
days.lab_task: Deploy node_exporter to the fleet with Ansible, build host dashboards, write alerts for disk, memory, load and failed units with runbooks and trigger each alert.
days.deliverable: Deployment playbook, dashboards, alert rules and runbooks
checks: Disk alert fires with a runbook link

subtopics: High load with no obvious cause
days.lab_task: Diagnose five injected incidents (an OOM kill loop, a disk full of deleted files, file descriptor exhaustion, intermittent DNS timeouts and clock drift), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review
checks: Cause found and memory limits set
Limit raised and the leak reported

days.lab_task: Complete two timed RHCE practice exams writing playbooks against fresh managed nodes, review failed tasks and repeat weak areas.
days.deliverable: Two scored practice exams and a weak-areas list

days.lab_task: Design and build a Linux platform for a payments service: golden images, central identity, an HA cluster, compliance automation, fleet monitoring, patch rings and backups, then run a game day with node failure, an emergency CVE and a security incident.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, automation repository, game day report and review presentation
checks: Fail a cluster node in the game day
Roll out the emergency CVE fix
Fleet patched within the time limit
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
